summary: A labelled group of six overlapping avatars: three photos and three initials, capped at four with an overflow chip counting the other two.
use: Showing who is on a review, task or document when only the first few fit: the chip says how many more, in the page language.
spec: `const reviewers` has 6 entries: Alice, Bob and Clara with `src`, Davi, Eva and Fabio without
`<AvatarGroup items={reviewers} max={4} label="Reviewers" />` renders four avatars and a chip for the rest
